title: theme override + rotated thumbnails
description:
Owner request 2026-11-14: "user footage'i sağa sola
döndürdüyse thumbnail'in ikonu da sağa sola dönmeli ki user
familiar olsun" — a clip the user rotated in the editor must
show its rotated look in the Library row.

Design choice — Option A (regenerate the icon file on rotation
change) over Option B (display-time rotation via graphicsLayer):
manual rotation is per-clip, persisted, and a discrete ±90 tap
in the clip-info sheet, not an interactive-frequent gesture, so
a one-off re-develop is cheap — and the file is then physically
correct everywhere (no per-display transform to keep in sync
with the persisted value). The editor's onRotate now removes the
clip's thumbnail after the rotation persists: ThumbnailStore's
remove deletes both the icon and any stale master, and the next
Library open's bounded backfill regenerates with the fresh
rotation (the same re-scan gate the import path uses
